journey.name: Password manager — save the phrase, check it, and restore from it
journey.description:
The one backup that survives losing the phone and asks the user to understand nothing. Android only: iOS withholds the offer.
It needs a device with a credential provider — a Google account with Password Manager on, or a third-party one set under Settings → Passwords, passkeys and accounts. An emulator with neither answers every save and every read with nothing, which is the empty path below and nothing more.
Two things matter more than the happy path. A save is not a backup until the phrase has been read back out and compared, so a provider that says "saved" while storing nothing must not retire the backup nag. And the entry's id is the account's pubky: two accounts saved from one device are two entries, and neither confirms the other.

actions.action: SAVE. Signed in with a key Loopky holds and has not backed up: Profile → "profile_backup_nag" → "backup_method_password_manager"
Verify "backup_phrase_save_manager" is absent while the words are blurred; reveal them and verify it appears
Tap "backup_phrase_save_manager". In the system sheet, verify the username is the account's full pubky (52 characters), not "Loopky", and save
The picker is raised straight after for the read-back: choose the entry just saved. Verify "backup_phrase_manager_saved" appears and "profile_backup_nag" is gone from Profile
CANCEL. On another un-backed-up account, tap "backup_phrase_save_manager" and dismiss the sheet. Verify "backup_phrase_manager_failed" appears and the nag is still on Profile
CHECK. Back up → Recovery phrase → reveal → "backup_phrase_continue". Verify the screen is the saved-phrase check ("backup_quiz_saved_check"), not the three-word quiz
Tap "backup_quiz_saved_check" and pick the entry. Verify it returns to the backup menu

TWO ACCOUNTS. With a second account saved from the same device, tap "backup_quiz_saved_check": verify the picker offers this account's entry, and that choosing the other account's (if the provider lists it anyway) shows "backup_quiz_saved_wrong"
RESTORE. Sign out. "onboarding_restore" → verify "restore_method_manager" is the third card, under the phrase and the file
Tap "restore_method_manager". Verify the picker is raised without a second tap, over the phrase screen with "restore_seed_warning" on it
Pick the entry. Verify the field fills, "restore_phrase_submit" reads "Checking…", and Loopky lands on home signed in as that pubky

EMPTY. Sign out, "restore_method_manager" again, and dismiss the picker. Verify "restore_phrase_manager_empty" appears, the field is editable, and the picker is NOT raised again by rotating the device
Tap "restore_phrase_from_manager" and verify the picker comes back; then type a phrase by hand and verify the empty note clears
From "restore_method_phrase" (the typed path), verify "restore_phrase_from_manager" is offered there too and that nothing is raised on entry
LEGACY ENTRY. With an entry saved by a build older than this one (username "Loopky"), run CHECK and RESTORE again: both must still accept it
TABLET. On a tablet in both orientations, verify the three restore cards and the phrase screen's secondary button sit inside the centred column
